# AC claim-family and R33 actor-graph protocol

**ID:** PD-GOV-AC-CLAIMS-R33-20260922-01

Apply whenever Francisco de Borja Rodríguez-Batllori Laffitte, the Administrador Concursal, RPL 3304/2025, R33, removal, remuneration, DP 1956, 2018 access/control, ONA/Clubotel, counsel interference or an AC-linked professional interaction is in scope.

1. Read `assets/data/ac-claims-r33-crosswalk-v1.json` and use the relevant stable `AC-CLM-*` ID.
2. Keep the AC distinct from the five private actors, judge, prosecutors, law firms and other institutions.
3. Preserve exact capacity and date for every act/omission.
4. R33 is a party filing and evidential response node. Never promote it to an adjudicated fact and never label it globally false without proposition-specific proof.
5. Every claim presentation must carry the strongest contrary/lawful explanation and material adverse outcome.
6. Shared source material may connect removal, remuneration, criminal and appellate lanes but must not imply procedural merger.
7. Counsel-related AC claims also require `PD-LAW-TRUTH-20260922-01`; number of lawyer changes is not causation.
8. New AC material must either extend an existing claim family or receive a new stable ID; do not create unnumbered competing lists.
9. Before public deployment, verify the AC hub and R33 pages link bidirectionally to the register and preserve ES/EN parity.
10. Private mailbox/file locators, privileged advice, live strategy and unnecessary personal data stay outside public Git.

The register supports investigation and falsification. It does not declare criminal, civil, disciplinary or insolvency liability.
